course.title: Surveying
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: What is offset? What are the conditions to be fulfilled to draw a perpendicular (06 offset?

topics: Reconnaissance survey; Linear measurements; Traverse survey; Plane table survey; Levelling & contouring; Calculation of areas and volumes; Tachometry: Introduction, principles and problems on tachometry; Astronomical surveying: Definition, instruments, astronomical corrections, systems of time; Introduction of terrestrial photography, aerial photography, reading of photo mosaic, scale Project surveying; Errors in surveying; remote sensing; Introduction and application of global positioning system (GPS) and geographical information system (GIS), House setting.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটি অফসেট এবং সমকোণী রেখা আঁকার পদ্ধতি নিয়ে যা সিলেবাসের 'Linear measurements' ও 'Traverse survey'-এর মৌলিক ধারণার অন্তর্ভুক্ত।
verification_notes: অফসেট এবং সমকোণী রেখা আঁকার পদ্ধতি সত্যিই Linear measurements ও Traverse survey-এর মৌলিক অংশ।
